text: I took this backpack on a weekend trip and came away mostly impressed. The straps stayed comfortable even after hours of walking, and the main compartment held everything I needed. The side pocket was a bit awkward for grabbing my water bottle, and one zipper caught once, but overall it performed well.
task: Write a fictional first-person review of a backpack after a weekend trip: comfortable straps, awkward side pocket, and a zipper that caught once.
